Requirement: Kids route must render Kids UI from the discovered Vite entry
AcceptanceRule: Manual smoke confirms Kids page loads on active localhost port

Requirement: All copy must be child-safe, encouraging, short, and non-punitive
AcceptanceRule: No harsh failure language; feedback gives simple next step

Requirement: Kids modes must be age-appropriate and simpler than Adults modes
AcceptanceRule: Modes use playful, short, calm labels

Requirement: Gameplay content must use structured prompts, choices, correct answer, hint, and insight
AcceptanceRule: Seed content model exists before source patch

Requirement: Scoring must reward attempts, accuracy, focus, and improvement without adult-style pressure
AcceptanceRule: Kids scoring model and mastery thresholds exist

Requirement: Kids storage keys must not collide with Adults storage keys
AcceptanceRule: Kids-specific storage keys are documented and tested

Requirement: Build smoke, manual smoke, regression, and repo clean proof required
AcceptanceRule: QA evidence committed and repo clean
